scope: Guide copy only, in Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and English, plus release version updates. 66 existing smoke and 31 app-language checks; six Chromium guide content/layout/scroll/close scenarios across three languages and portrait/landscape. limitations: This is a documentation update; no new app feature or interaction was implemented.
